items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Yeah, oh yeah, way before I was a small kid.

ctx.x: All those comedians came, I'll bet. Yeah. All the great comedians of the 50s, black comedians, all came to the Dewdrop. You know Scoey Mitchell? Scoey Mitchell used to work at the Dewdrop. You didn't know that, huh? Yeah. Started out, we used to work for a long time at the Dewdrop. But anyway, we'll get back to you. That's where Roy Brown. Yeah, Roy Brown and all of us, everybody was at the Dewdrop. So what about, so you met, so this was before you were doing music, you met Lollipop?
Yeah, oh yeah, way before I was a small kid.
What year was this when you said you went with the Minstrel Show? Oh, I was small.
